name: Tiger warriors
description: The Jamuraan cat warrior tribes created by Terrent Amese, who split into the Hooraree, Efravan, Khyyiani and Sulaki.

description_citations.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese fuses man and tiger to create the first tribe of tiger warriors to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood.
timeline.quote: who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojanen leads the tribe in building the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale as a place of worship and watch-post.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese named the first tiger warrior Ojanen

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojanen realizes his people are slave labor and Terrent Amese no god, and rallies the tribe to seek independence.
timeline.quote: He rallied his tribe behind him and tried to obtain their independence from their creator.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese curses the Ojanen line, creates Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe, and disappears; Ojanen fights the beast while the tribe flees Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese cursed the Ojanen line and created the monster Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe before disappearing, never to be seen again.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The tribe settles in the Sukurvian Desert and splinters into four bands.
timeline.quote: The tribe would settle in the Sukurvian Desert

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit rediscovers the tribes' origins, and the four tribes make peace, return to Scarwood, rebuild the Tabernacle and found an empire.
timeline.quote: The four tribes would end up making peace with one another

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Created the first tribe by fusing man and tiger.
relations.quote: who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger.

relations.note: Named leader and guide of the tribe.
relations.quote: and he was to be the leader and guide of the tribe
